pages.title: A closed six-region network
pages.text:
A closed six-region network
The regions are L V, systemic arteries, systemic veins, RV, pulmonary arteries and
pulmonary veins.
Four ideal valves and two open vascular beds connect them; no external
reservoir appears.

pages.title: A periodically forced state
pages.text:
A periodically forced state
Pressures and compartment volumes change throughout a beat. Total volume remains
constant.
P (t + Tb) ≃ P (t)
describes periodicity, not a stationary pressure.
Computational Cardiology Notes 9 / 20

Phase-aligned comparison

A small return-map residual measures the remaining transient. It does not measure
time-step error.

pages.title: Implicit coupling
pages.text:
Implicit coupling
New compliances and new pressures enter the hydraulic balance together.
The pressure
solve must also satisfy the ideal-valve inequalities; an algebraically conserved state can still
have inconsistent valve labels.
Computational Cardiology Notes 20 / 20
